A skill to interact with Gaode Map (AMap) for location search and route planning.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Gaode Map Skill.

- Enables location search and route planning via the Gaode (AMap) API.
- Supports POI (Point of Interest) search with keywords and optional city filtering.
- Provides route planning between origins and destinations with modes like driving, walking, bicycling, and transit.
- Requires an AMap API key set through the AMAP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Offers command-line usage with clear parameters and example commands.
